fixes.explanation: Yep, that's the group. The text says, "…all the men of Israel deserted David to follow Sheba son of Bichri." (2 Samuel 20:2) I've been left in a drawer before, and I'm telling you, that kind of leaving stings. The men of Judah stayed by their king, but Israel's men left him for Sheba.

True, baker, and the text says it plainly. "But the men of Judah stayed by their king all the way from the Jordan to Jerusalem." (2 Samuel 20:2) While the men of Israel go after Sheba, Judah stays right with David. That's a long way to stay beside him.
